svg.title: Raw school phone policy excerpt
svg.desc: A raw policy excerpt with highlighted exception language that conflicts with an AI summary.
svg.text: Updated: 12 Aug 2026 | Source: School handbook page 42
4.2 Mobile phones during the school day
Students should keep phones stored during lessons unless a teacher gives permission
for a learning activity, accessibility need, translation, or emergency communication.
Teachers may require phones to be placed face down or returned to bags after use.
Repeated misuse should be handled through the normal behavior process.
AI summary shown to staff: “Phones are banned all day.”
